description: Four decisions in one call, every one of them written a level down inside a `cookie` group -- which is why none of it was readable until the frontends started reading nested options. The store is identified by the presence of a `secret` rather than by its name: express-session, cookie-session and koa-session all take it, and a list of the ones somebody thought of would be wrong at the next wrapper.

expected.note: a session signing key in the source means anybody holding the repository can mint a session
written as cookie.httpOnly, matched on the last segment
